summary.text: Create Dream is a dream path immortal killer move. Meng Qiu Zhen uses it to defend his soul by nesting a dream within a dream.

claims.text: Near the end of a dream realm exploration, Meng Qiu Zhen nearly loses himself to surging sadness, anger, and hatred. He activates Create Dream. In a newly created dream within a dream he stands in a large room burning with blue flames, extinguishes the fire, and survives. He then dispels the killer move dream within dream and returns to the original dream realm.

Inside a heaven path dream realm blessed land, Meng Qiu Zhen activates create dream killer move to create countless firm rock spikes out of nothing, turning most of a rock field into a land of spikes before an earthly calamity arrives.

He uses create dream killer move to create earth spikes and uses earth trenches and caverns to kill the four-armed ape. Without create dream he would have no earth spikes, and the ape would live a long time until it died of hunger and the blessed land digested it. With the spikes he quickly kills the ape and absorbs enough strength path dao marks to split the rock land.
